title: FirstService Residential-managed Bulle Rock Community Takes Home 2026 Community Association of the Year Award from CAI-Chesapeake
body_markdown:
# FirstService Residential-managed Bulle Rock Community Takes Home 2026 Community Association of the Year Award from CAI-Chesapeake


Monday October 26, 2026


FirstService Residential, North America’s leading residential community management company, received a prestigious honor from the Community Associations Institute’s Chesapeake chapter at its annual expo and symposium on October 5. The award was presented to the Bulle Rock Community Association, a community managed by FirstService in Havre De Grace, Maryland.


The 2026 Community Association of the Year award recognizes the work it takes to build and sustain a successful community. The board is a strong steward of governance and compliance, financial administration and reserve planning, facility and asset management, resident engagement, volunteerism, and involvement in CAI. The community brings those accomplishments to life. Bulle Rock has more than 1,600 homes and over 40 resident-led clubs and groups, with opportunities to connect across generations and interests. The community’s volunteer committees help shape community life, while residents give their time to charitable outreach, neighborhood projects, and traditions such as Flags for Military Heroes.


“This honor reflects what’s possible when engaged residents, committed community leaders, and an experienced management team work together with a shared vision,” said Trent Harrison, President, MidAtlantic, FirstService Residential. “The Bulle Rock management team continues to set the standard for community excellence.”


"This recognition is a tremendous honor for Bulle Rock and validates the collective commitment of our board, our volunteer committees, and our residents," said Jim Kurtz, President of the Bulle Rock Community Association Board of Directors. "Partnering with the GM, Chris Petrik, and the dedicated on-site FirstService Residential team has provided our community with the operational rigor, financial discipline, and leadership needed to set the standard across Maryland. We are extremely proud of this shared milestone."


FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.


As the leading residential community management company, FirstService Residential partners with boards and residents to protect and enhance property values, elevate resident lifestyles, and deliver customized solutions tailored to the unique needs of every community. Through local market expertise, proven operational excellence, and a steadfast commitment to service, FirstService Residential helps communities realize their vision today while creating lasting value for the future.


**About FirstService Residential**


Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community’s specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.


Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.


FirstService Residential is a subsidiary of FirstService Corporation (NASDAQ and TSX: FSV), a North American leader in providing essential property services to a wide range of residential and commercial clients.
